locations.title: Sink Auto-Doc
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Sink](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=484613) - At the edge of the main room, near the doorway leading to the elevators.  

**Services:**
- Restores health, removes radiation and addictions.
- Changes your face
- Changes your hairstyle
- Changes your Traits (but only once)
- Swaps your implanted heart and spine for the originals, and vice versa
- Sells a variety of implants after their upgrades are installed:
  - C-13 - +10% damage to Cazadores
  - M-5 - Increased speed while crouched
  - Y-3 - Drinking irradiated water does not increase your Rads
  - Y-7 - Bonus HP / AP from food

**Note(s):**
- Activated via [Sink Project: Auto-Doc](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=499556)
- Upgraded with:
  - [Auto-Doc Upgrade: Hair Styling Enhancements](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=499168)
  - [Auto-Doc Upgrade: Implant M-5](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=499185)
  - [Auto-Doc Upgrade: Implant Y-3](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=499190)
  - [Auto-Doc Upgrade: Implant Y-7](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=499531)
  - [Auto-Doc Upgrade: Implant C-13](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=499557)

locations.title: Doctor 0
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Think Tank](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=484654) - At the far left side of the room, facing a console.  

**Note(s):**
- Gives 50 Caps every 24 hours if you pass a Barter 50 check when speaking to [Doctor Klein](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=499003) for the first time.
- Ask about his name and pass a Speech 65 check to begin [What's in a Name?](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=485218)
- Spoken to as part of [When Visitors Attack!](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=485245)

locations.title: Doctor Dala
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Think Tank](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=484654) - On the left side of the room, facing some screens.  

**Note(s):**
- Passing a Perception 8 check, using the Lady Killer / Cherchez La Femme perk, or bringing her a teddy bear begins the [Coming Out of Her Shell](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=485216) quest.
- Asking what she does here, then asking about her title, begins the quest [He Came... And Went](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=485228)
- A dialogue choice in her quest ("I'll tell the others if you don't make it worth my while.") yields 1 Conductor, 1 Wonderglue, and 1 Pre-War Money every 24 hours.
- The other choice ("I could come back any time and just breathe, if you want.") yields Drained Electron Charge Packs, Drained Microfusion Cells, and Drained Small Energy Cells.

locations.title: Doctor Klein
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Think Tank](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=484654) - At the top of the stairs in the middle of the room, facing a blue screen.  

**Note(s):**
- Spoken to as part of [He Came... And Went](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=485228)
- Asking "Why do I have this strange... passive sensation in here?" and "Why the anti-aggression programming?", then "Who were these visitors?" begins [When Visitors Attack!](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=485245)

locations.title: Doctor 8
locations.description:
**Location:** [The Think Tank](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=484654) - On the right side of the room, facing the wires.  

**Note(s):**
- Pass a Perception 7 and two Science 75 checks to begin the [On the Same Wavelength](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=485244) quest.
- Can add [Higgs Village](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=484650) to your map.
- Certain dialogue choices yield 2 Duct Tape + 2 Cram + [¡La Fantoma!](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=499103) + every 24 hours for male couriers.
- Female couriers will receive 10 microfusion cells + [Tæles of Chivalrie](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=499103) instead.
- Both couriers will also receive copies of [Programmer's Digest + Fixin' Things](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=499107) and a sensor module if they ask if he's made "any new discoveries today".
- Asking if he has anything to "pass" the "time", then clarifying "I mean, literally, got anything to help pass the time?" yields an egg timer.

locations.title: Gremlins reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

The doghouse has a new inhabitant - a tiny Deathclaw named Stripe, named after a Gremlin of the same name in Gremlins (1984). The chicken leg that appears in front of the dog house is a reference to Stripe's favourite food.

locations.title: Doctor Who reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only occurs with the Wild Wasteland trait.

Y-17 Trauma Harnesses will occasionally say "Hey, who turned out the lights?", referencing the all-time banger of a Doctor Who episode ['Silence in the Library'.](https://youtu.be/enG6Z3zqOWE?si=2KjU2hZRnMX4db3_)

In the episode, anyone caught in the dark has their flesh devoured - but their spacesuit continues to walk around, repeating their last words, with nothing but skeletal remains inside.

locations.title: Snow White reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

Around the red crystals surrounding the [Construction Site](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=484672), you can find seven garden gnomes alongside pickaxes and lanterns.

This references the seven dwarves from the1937 film 'Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.'

locations.title: The Venture Bros reference
locations.description:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

Found throughout the [Magnetohydraulics Complex](https://mapgenie.io/fallout-new-vegas/maps/big-mt?locationIds=484614), the four Walking Eyes are a reference to robots that appear in The Venture Bros.
